chunks: Indeed, it is from the right of the guest that a toothpick be prepared for him.

key_terms.الْخِلَالُ: a toothpick prepared for cleaning the teeth
key_terms.يُعَدَّ: to be prepared or made ready

ai.seo_question: What are the rights of a guest in Islamic etiquette?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an aspect of hospitality and refined etiquette toward guests. It presents preparing a toothpick for the guest as part of the guest’s due right, reflecting attentiveness to comfort and cleanliness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Indeed, it is from the rights of the guest that a toothpick is prepared for him."
